title: External editor command doesnt execute when script editor feature is disabled
body:
### Tested versions

4.5.beta3

### System information

Manjaro Linux

### Issue description

I've tested many commands and scripts to try to see the configured "External Editor" command get triggered when I double-click a script in my project. Nothing I tried would execute anything. I realized my "Script Editor" feature was disabled and once I re-enabled it my external editor commands worked as expected.

Could it be possible to communicate that the use of an external editor is dependent on having the integrated script editor feature enabled?

### Steps to reproduce

Editor Settings:
**Text Editor -> External** 
- Exec Path: `sh`
- Exec Flags: `-c "echo 'hello world' >> /tmp/test.txt"
- Use External Editor: On

Editor Features:
- Script Editor: Off

Now, try to open a script. I would expect "hello world" to appear in the file `/tmp/test.txt` for this example, but alas nothing.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I can't provide a project, but here are editor configuration file lines and a feature profile that you can add/replace in your `editor_settings-4.5.tres` file found [here](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/tutorials/io/data_paths.html#editor-data-paths)

**{godot_config}/editor_settings-4.5.tres**
```
...
text_editor/external/exec_path = "sh"
text_editor/external/exec_flags = "-c \"echo 'hello world' >> /tmp/test.txt\""
text_editor/external/use_external_editor = true
...
```
**{godot_config}/feature_profiles/test.profile**
```
{
        "disabled_classes": [],
        "disabled_editors": [],
        "disabled_features": [
                "script"
        ],
        "disabled_properties": [],
        "type": "feature_profile"
```

make sure to select the "test" feature profile in the **Editor -> Manage Editor Features...** menu.
